brief:
An Israeli military strike targeted a residential house in the Beit Lahia project in northern Gaza, Eye on Palestine reported. The attack resulted in multiple deaths and a significant number of injuries among residents at the site.

Children and women were among those killed and wounded in the strike, according to the outlet's account. The exact toll of casualties was not immediately clarified in initial reports of the incident.
